svg.title: Festio Juniors complete workflow: daily arrival, screening, every return and verified pickup

text.tspan: Every child accounted for. Every handoff recorded.
Use the event’s schedule and permissions.
FIRST ARRIVAL: convention check-in before JP custody. EACH JP DAY: a fresh drop-off from the configured JP start date.
Ask what is missing; confirm both with the adult today.
Both Yes → both desks; not either/or.
STANDARD BAND FOR EVERY SCREENED CHILD · BOTH NEEDS = STANDARD + ALLERGY + ACCOMMODATION (3 BANDS) · CONFIRM DAILY
Every temporary movement has its own complete return cycle
Returning for the rest of the day? Confirm classroom arrival. Leaving for the day? Record return first, then verified pickup.
Email + SMS notices are recorded. Actual sending needs enabled switches,
contacts, consent, provider readiness and credits. Practice events never send.
Failed / setup required / uncertain → review before retrying
Correct child records and collector authorization.
Issue, return, damage or loss; record responsibility.
EVENT OPT-IN • REUSABLE FOR FUTURE JUNIOR PROGRAMMES • EXISTING EVENT FLOWS PRESERVED
